description: Source file containing utility functions for filesystem and file I/O operations, including file copying, reading, writing, directory management, and deletion.

methods.name: int deleteDirHandler(const char * pathname,const char * dname,unsigned char dtype,void * private)
methods.description: Deletes a file, directory, or symlink within a directory, handling different file types.

methods.name: int copyDirHandler(const char * pathname,const char * dname,unsigned char dtype,void * private)
methods.description: Recursively copies a directory or file from source to destination, preserving permissions and handling symlinks.

methods.name: int mkdir_p(const char * path,mode_t mode)
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories with specified permissions.

methods.name: char * readFileContents(const char * filename)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified ASCII file into memory.

methods.name: char * readFileContentsWithTrim(const char * filename)
methods.description: Reads file contents and trims a trailing newline if present.

methods.name: bool writeContentsToFileName(const char * filename,const char * contents)
methods.description: Writes given contents to a specified file, creating or overwriting it safely.

methods.name: bool copyFile(FILE * source,FILE * dest)
methods.description: Copies data from one FILE stream to another.

methods.name: bool copyFileByPath(const char * sourcePath,const char * destPath)
methods.description: Copies a file from source path to destination path.

methods.name: bool moveFile(const char * sourcePath,const char * destPath)
methods.description: Moves a file from source to destination, handling cross-filesystem moves.

methods.name: bool doesNonEmptyFileExist(const char * filename)
methods.description: Checks whether a non-empty file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: bool doesFileExist(const char * filename)
methods.description: Checks whether a file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: bool doesDirExist(const char * dirPath)
methods.description: Checks whether a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: int listDirectory(const char * dir,directoryHandler handler,void * private)
methods.description: Lists contents of a directory, invoking a handler function for each entry.

methods.name: bool deleteDirectory(const char * path)
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: bool copyDirectory(const char * src,const char * dst)
methods.description: Copies an entire directory and its contents from source to destination.

methods.name: bool createMarkerFile(const char * path)
methods.description: Creates a zero-length marker file at the specified path.

ctags.name: copyDirHandler
ctags.pattern: /^static int copyDirHandler(const char* pathname, const char* dname, unsigned char dtype, void* pr/
ctags.signature: (const char * pathname,const char * dname,unsigned char dtype,void * private)

ctags.name: copyDirectory
ctags.pattern: /^bool copyDirectory(const char* src, const char* dst)$/

ctags.name: deleteDirHandler
ctags.pattern: /^int deleteDirHandler(const char* pathname, const char* dname, unsigned char dtype, void* private/
ctags.signature: (const char * pathname,const char * dname,unsigned char dtype,void * private)

ctags.name: listDirectory
ctags.pattern: /^int listDirectory(const char* dir, directoryHandler handler, void* private)$/
